cost_model: half-spread 3 bps + impact 7 bps = 10 bps one-way (C1, order 9-Sept), charged per SESSION as compute_nav does: 10 bps × one-way turnover, where one-way turnover = 0.5 × Σ|w_after − w_before| over every name and the cash sleeve on the pre-trade NAV of the session; levied once from cash and allocated pro rata by traded value to the session's trade rows (cost_basis on each row). A swap of A for B of value x costs 10 bps × x; a cash-funded buy of x costs 10 bps × x.

rules_summary.entry: a RANK_ENTRY or SEED buys a name only when its entry state on that session is READY (the full slot weight, (1 − target_cash)/K) or READY-HALF (half the slot weight; the other half stays in cash). A name in WATCH or AVOID is skipped and the next-ranked name in a READY state is taken
rules_summary.stop: the stop is the entry-state stop recorded on the day of purchase and stays fixed. A close below it sells the name with reason code STOP_EXIT. RANK_EXIT stays as in the c twins
rules_summary.re_entry: a name sold at its stop can be bought again only after a later session shows it READY or READY-HALF
